text: QGCreateAmp[nLoops, {"InParticle1[p1]","InParticle1[p2]", ...} -> {"OutParticle1[k1]", "OutParticle1[k2]", ...}] calls QGRAF to generate Feynman amplitudes and (optionally) the corresponding diagrams, using the specified model and style files.
The function returns a list with the paths to two files, where the first file contains the amplitudes and the second file the diagrams (graphical representations of the amplitudes).
